name: St. Georgen im Schwarzwald (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged below the centre with the city arms of St. Georgen im Schwarzwald (Saint George slaying the dragon on white).
history: Municipal flag of St. Georgen im Schwarzwald; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
